tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List every service and client type Blue Dot Brdg (BLDT, India) publishes on bldt.in, with a summary, what it includes and the page to read.

tools.name: recommend_services
tools.description: Recommend the Blue Dot Brdg services that fit a business need, such as a foreign brand entering India, an Indian brand exporting, or a founder who wants the brand run end to end. Returns the best matches with their pages. Every engagement is quoted after the diagnostic.

tools.name: request_exploratory_call
tools.description: Ask Blue Dot Brdg for an exploratory call on the user's behalf. Only use this when the user has agreed to share these details with Blue Dot Brdg to arrange the call, and set user_consented to true. The team replies by email; nothing is booked or confirmed by this request.
